entries.subject: SDSS DR9 color HiPS
entries.finding: An 1800 x 1800 px hips2fits cutout of CDS/P/SDSS9/color, 8.0 arcmin wide on the 2MASS position. The core does not saturate (peak 184 of 255) and the light reaches the sky level about 240 arcsec out.

entries.subject: DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys DR10 color HiPS
entries.finding: Baked first, on 2026-10-02, and replaced. The composite saturates within about 10 arcsec of the core, which left a boxy core with bright lobes from the side and from above, and green and pink rings in the halo. It also carries a diffraction streak from HD 112887 and a strip of bad columns east of the core.

entries.subject: Catalogues for the masks
entries.finding: HyperLEDA PGC alone left galaxies it lists without a D25 in the image; the 2MASS Extended Source Catalog sizes them. NOX leaves the haloes of bright stars, so Gaia DR3 stars brighter than G = 15 are masked too. At M87's three D25 radii a close neighbour's mask covers NGC 4874's own centre, so each mask stops at half its distance from the centre.

entries.subject: Spheroid
entries.finding: Kluge et al. (2020), Table 4, row A1656: single Sérsic n = 9.00 +/- 0.90, r_e = 784 kpc. Their brightest cluster galaxy for Abell 1656 is NGC 4874. Used as published; no fit was made here.

entries.subject: Dullo (2019) three-component fit
entries.finding: Dullo's Tables 3 and 4 fit NGC 4874 with a core-Sérsic spheroid (n 4.0, R_e 4.9 arcsec), a Sérsic component (n 0.80, R_e 46.5 arcsec) and an exponential halo (scale 175.3 arcsec). The lab's isophote fill takes one Sérsic spheroid.
entries.revisitWhen: The lab fills masks for more than one spheroid.

entries.subject: Globular cluster dots
entries.finding: Not drawn. Dots on a volume bank are listed in a table in the site's code, which this change does not touch.
entries.revisitWhen: The site table can take a new bank.
